462897: **Description:** *A large bridge that spans the old border.  It was the only means of crossing the Frontier River without wading through the water.  Bandits have been known to attack travelers along the bridge, which now sits littered with abandoned cars.*
462898: **Description:** *A river known for the cacti that grow along its banks.  It has been known to swell to the width of one or two ladders in times of heavy timefall upstream.*
462899: **Description:** *Joining the sea at the Gulf of Mexico, this river once formed part of the US-Mexico border.  Its tributaries upstream area usually dried up, but the water level has been known to rise rapidly during periods of heavy timefall.*
462900: **Description:** *A BT area that spreads out to the south of the Ciudad Nudo del Norte (C1).  The tar in this area has been used to dispose of corpses from C1 for a long time.  As a result, chiral density has increased and BTs have started appearing in the vicinity.*
462901: **Description:** *A steep hill with dense vegetation located between Villa Libre and the C1 South Distribution Center.  The hill takes its name from the mysterious spider-like creatures that many people have reported seeing in the area.*
462902: **Description:** *A river that flows through central Mexico.  It passes through Bandit territory, and many porters have reported being attacked while trying to cross.*
462903:
**Warning Type:** Cliff  

**Description:** *A steep slope that has tested even the most capable of porters.  Legend has it that no pair of boots are sturdy enough to survive the climb.  True or not, you'd do well to remember such warnings if you try to scramble up...*
462904: **Description:** *High chiral density has been detected in this BT area.  According to reports, abandoned cargo can be found around the ruined church at its center.*
462905: **Description:** *The remains of an old crater.  It is unclear when or how it was formed.  Pieces of cargo that are believed to have become stranded are often found in the area.*
